summary.text: Pam Queen, a Democrat, represents District 14 (Montgomery County) in the Maryland House of Delegates and is listed on the Economic Matters Committee.

paragraphs.text: Queen was born in New York, New York, in 1960.

The legislature's biography lists a B.S. in mathematics from Tuskegee University in 1983, master's degrees in computer science and management from The Johns Hopkins University, and a Ph.D. in finance from George Washington University in 2010.
It lists Queen as an assistant professor at Morgan State University from 2010 to the present.
